title: Leica GS05 GNSS Smart Antenna
summary:
The GS05 is the lightweight GNSS smart antenna: 0.75 kg on the pole, small enough to fit in the palm of your hand. It carries 4G, UHF radio, tilt compensation and an IP-rated shell, which is a lot of instrument for something that barely registers on the pole.

Tilt compensation is calibration-free and immune to magnetic disturbances, so there is no bubble to level and no drift around steel and machinery. 184 channels, 10 mm + 1 ppm RTK on a single baseline, and RTK initialisation typically in 6 seconds.

It runs Leica Captivate on a CS20, CS30, CC180 or CC200 controller, works with Leica Infinity and GeoCloud Drive, and can even be combined with total station operation as a SmartPole. The GS05 is also a named sensor in the Leica X-PAD portfolio, so a crew already running X-PAD keeps one interface and one data format across GNSS and total station.
specs: 184 channels, multi-frequency multi-constellation: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, SBAS
RTK single baseline: H 10 mm + 1 ppm / V 20 mm + 1 ppm; network RTK H 10 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 20 mm + 0.5 ppm
Tilt-compensated RTK: additional H uncertainty under 1.5 cm down to 30 degrees tilt, calibration-free and magnetically resistant
Static with long observations: H 3 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 6 mm + 0.5 ppm; static and rapid static H 5 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 10 mm + 0.5 ppm
Built-in 4G LTE modem and UHF radio 413-473 MHz on the matching variants
Internal Li-Ion 6.0 Ah / 3.6 V, typical operating time up to 10 h
0.75 kg (2.82 kg standard RTK rover setup on pole); 118.9 x 118.9 x 75.5 mm
IP66 / IP68, -30 to +55 degrees C on internal power, -40 to +65 on external power
Data recording: Leica GNSS raw data and RINEX at up to 10 Hz, up to 4 GB internal memory
accessories: Leica CS20, CS30, CC180 or CC200 field controller
Leica CSX8 controller tablet with Leica X-PAD
Leica TS13 robotic total station for a hybrid GNSS and total station setup: the total station tracks a prism on the antenna
